subject: CLOSE statement
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB140): the '42' guard was already on FileConnector.Close; the two wrongful halves are closed. CLOSE WITH LOCK locks ONLY on a success-family close - an unsuccessful ('42') CLOSE performs none of its closing actions, so the later OPEN answers '00', never the poisoned '38' (pb140_close_lock pins 42/00/00/38). The keyed REEL/UNIT arm that set NO status at all is unreachable now (SR-14.9.6.3-1 rejects at bind; the runtime surface throws the compiler-defect invariant if reached) - and pb140_close_status pins '42' on a never-opened and a twice-closed file. || editions corrected from '85,2002,2014' to 85,2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): a facility that exists at every edition (the COBOL-85 nucleus, I-O, inter-program and SPECIAL-NAMES implementor-names; its arithmetic, the only arithmetic of COBOL-85, is what later editions name native).
